name: Obed-edom
overview: Obed-edom was a male figure known as the Gittite in whose house the ark of the covenant rested, as recorded in 2 Samuel 6:10. His tribal affiliation is not specified in Scripture. There are no additional notes provided about his life or character.
namesAndTitles: The name Obed-edom means 'servant [worshiper] of Edom' and is a proper name mentioned in 2 Samuel 6:10. This name reflects a personal designation but was not given by God according to the biblical record.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Obed-edom beyond what is indicated in his unique attribute as the Gittite who housed the ark of the covenant. No further relationships are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Obed-edom holds significance in the biblical narrative as the faithful individual whose home became the temporary resting place for the ark of the covenant. This event underscores God's presence and blessing upon Obed-edom's household during the ark's stay. His role highlights the reverence due to the ark and God's willingness to dwell among His people through chosen vessels.
